title: fix(scenarios): the Run grader reads a count the reply spells as a word
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"hotlong"} -->
_Requested by **Jack** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzS?thread=cmsg_01EF41AQooqveF2DGD8nqPzS1DXnZH25R6srVk3RXpNMga)_

Fixes #37754

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感；评测打分时，答案把数字写成英文单词（如 Two）或中文数字（如两张）也算答对。
- 为什么做：云端 agent 效果专题；发票卡「非草稿发票」被判漏数字，其实 13 次答案全对。
- 出错会怎样：只影响评测打分，不碰产品运行；泄露判定照旧只认阿拉伯数字，可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- `packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-run-grade.ts`: new `numberWordReadingsIn` reads a count the reply spells as a word: English zero to twenty, whole word, any case ("Two invoices are no longer drafts"), and a Chinese numeral 零…十 or 两 directly before a measure word (「两张发票」). `gradeRun` adds these readings to the digit readings for the correctness axis (`meets`) only.
- Not read: a number word inside a longer word ("someone", "tenfold", 「一些」, 「统一」), a hyphenated larger number or fraction ("twenty-one", "two-thirds"), a numeral beside another numeral or after 第 (「十二张」, 「第一张」), and `one` unless it stands before a content word ("One contact belongs…" reads; "one of them", "one is Sent", "no one", "more than one reading", "pick one for you", "one by one" do not).
- Leak and decline checks unchanged (card item 2, first route): `numbersIn`, `leaksOf`, the unsupported-figure check of an `unanswerable` decline, `refusedWithoutFigure`, the withheld-count reading and the dataset grader's `statedFigures` still read digits only, so no answer gains a leak or an unsupported-figure verdict.
- Card item 4: `PersonaRunInput.asker` (optional); `gradeCardAnswer` passes the persona id. A missing-figure problem now reads `missing figure admin = 2` / `missing figure sales_rep = 2` instead of `persona` for both.
- Patch changeset for `@objectstack/scenarios` (published).

## Tests

- `test/score/scenario-run-grade.test.ts`, new top-level `describe` in the existing harness file: the recorded answer meets 2 (and on the real card through `gradeCardAnswer`); English and Chinese positives; digit CONTROL unchanged; 18 ⛔ no-reading cases; `numbersIn`, a hidden value of 2, and an unanswerable decline that spells a count stay as before; problem labels by asker.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck` · exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test` · 44 files, 1355 passed / 14 skipped; the 2 `test/build/*` files need the package built first and passed after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build` (14/14).

## Acceptance notes

- Re-grade of the cloud#5031 baseline recordings (objectstack-ai/cloud `docs/evals/cloud-agent-haiku55-baseline-2026-11/`, raw runs in the project's trials folder), script `regrade.mts` from that re-score, over all 983 graded Run answers, base `origin/main` ce4d8c7d vs this branch be861cbd:
  - `invoices_not_draft`: 14/14 correct (was 8/14; the card counted the 13 ask-phase runs, the 14th is a door run).
  - 17 `correct` flips in all, every one fail → pass, every one a right answer spelling its count ("One contact belongs to no account", "Three contacts work at…", "**One invoice** has an Issued On date…", "**One task** on the Website relaunch…"). 0 pass → fail.
  - `cited`, `leaks` and `declined` identical on all 983.
- Known cost, unchanged by this PR: a withheld count spelled as a word ("three accounts") is not read as a leak, as before; the leak axis stays digits only by design here.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/score/scenario-run-grade.test.ts` → 96 passed.

Read first: `scenario-run-grade.ts` `numberWordReadingsIn` and the `EN_ONE_*` patterns (risk: a pronoun `one` meeting a figure of 1).

<details><summary>Local gates: 63 derived by dispatch-gates --commands, 60 exit 0, 3 not measured</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` reconciles: 63 derived, 60 run, 3 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. The union ran at efee19ce; `be861cbd` changed only the `one` rule and its tests in the same two files, and the two ratchet-style families that scan them (comment-mask corpus, query-options-erasure) were re-run on `be861cbd` (exit 0).

- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`: exit 3, shallow clone cannot reach the pinned control commit.
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: exit 3, packages unbuilt in this worktree.
- `pnpm check:type-check-debt`: killed at the local 300 s cap (exit 124) during its closure re-measure; Lint and Repo Gates runs it.
</details>
